pokedexEntries.dp: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

pokedexEntries.hg: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it’s fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

pokedexEntries.x: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

pokedexEntries.or: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

pokedexEntries.y: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.

pokedexEntries.as: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.

pokedexEntries.sw: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

pokedexEntries.sh: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

pokedexEntries.la: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.
